name: Corner boost: chained hypers off two ledge corners
techNote: Three floors stepping down right: ledge 1 (top y 0, edge x 400), ledge 2 (top y -100, x 400-1960), ledge 3 (top y -500 from x 1960). Hop, dash down-right on the next tick: the landing turns the dash flat (canHyper) and it slides off ledge 1's edge still grounded (onGround held, coyoteFrames counting down), and the jump on dash frame 6 is a hyper off the corner (547 up, 1650 momentum right; lastHyperY there). Late in its fall, dash down-right again: it lands on ledge 2 on tick 56, slides off its edge on tick 59 and the jump (pressed at framesSinceLastDash 6, after the landing) is the second corner hyper on tick 63, 100 u under the first: the game's ultra check passes and adds preDashMomentum.x (548.8) to the hyper's 1650 (2146 after the tick, against 1609 for a plain hyper). That is the Ultra bonus, chained down ledges; nothing counts the momentum a third time. A jump pressed in the dash's air before its landing instead (buffered through it, firing at framesSinceLastDash 4) gets the preDashMomentum.x but not the 1650: in a shorter layout of this lab (ledge 2 edge x 1260, the second dash on input 12, jump on dash frame 9) the second corner hyper left with 1217.8. The second hyper's arc reaches the finish box over ledge 3 (x 3000-3100, y 15-95).
